lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters (~5-12 pixel diameter) arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular spots, forming a localized grid pattern on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Dominant horizontal linear feature on the upper flank displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient, separating the dorsal surface from the lateral mid-section.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark-pixel silhouettes (commensal remoras) trailing the ventral and pectoral regions.
